course_title: Foundations of Data Structures and Algorithms
makeup_policy: Make-ups are granted only for genuine reasons (e.g., medical issues) with prior permission: • Lab Test: Email the Instructor-in-Charge with documentary proof. • Mid-Term and Comprehensive Exam: Apply via the AUGSD portal. Make-up requests must be submitted to the Instructor-in-Charge at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled exam. Please note that make-up exams are generally more challenging than the regular ones.
